description: Source code for the XHTML Xtras plugin for TinyMCE, including plugin info, initialization, control HTML, command execution, cleanup, and node change handling.

classes.name: TinyMCE_XHTMLXtrasPlugin
classes.description: Object representing the XHTML Xtras plugin for TinyMCE, providing plugin info, initialization, control HTML, command execution, cleanup, and node change handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes the plugin instance by importing CSS into the editor document.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for plugin control buttons based on control name.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes plugin commands such as inserting cite, acronym, abbreviation, ins, del, or editing attributes via popup windows.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup on content, e.g., replacing <abbr> tags for IE browsers.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the editor node, updating button states based on selection.

methods.name: _anySel
methods.description: Checks if there is any selection or relevant element in the editor.
